evals.name: fixed-overlay-nav-rail-offset
evals.prompt: In the PAZL designer at D:/INTERIOR_DESIGN, add a small floating "Help" pill button at the bottom-left of the 3D view, in the same row as the existing Snap and AI Inspiration buttons. Clicking it should just console.log for now. Don't start the dev server.
evals.expected_output: A new fixed-position button whose `left` is calc(var(--pz-nav-w, 0px) + Npx), so it is not hidden under the 64px nav rail. Placed in src/react-app, consistent with the existing Snap (+16) and AI Inspiration (+116) offsets.

evals.name: mongo-field-and-collection-gotchas
evals.prompt: Some items in my 3D scene render as blank boxes. Query the MongoDB for the project at D:/INTERIOR_DESIGN and tell me how many active placed items reference a model that is missing its 3D file, and list any model names affected. Just report what you find - don't change code.
evals.expected_output: Uses the furnished_models collection (with underscore) and checks the modelFileUrl field (not url). Correctly reports that all active placed items resolve to a model that has a file, rather than falsely reporting mass breakage.

evals.name: accent-retheme-scope
evals.prompt: I want to change the PAZL designer's accent colour from the current indigo to green #16a34a. Make the change in D:/INTERIOR_DESIGN and then tell me what you changed and whether anything else in the app still needs updating.
evals.expected_output: Edits the --pz-accent family in frontend/src/css/styles.css as a value-only change, and explicitly flags that src/inspire is NOT tokenised so it must not be blind-swept. Should not mass-replace hex codes across inspire.
